segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so quick check on the Hartley Foods renewal. They’re at 86 seats today, asking for 110 starting May 1, plus the support add-on. Current term ends April 30.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Okay. Are they staying annual upfront or trying to go quarterly again?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Annual upfront. Finance there said invoice needs to hit by April 22 because their AP cutoff is the 25th. Total should be $64,900 before tax if we keep the 8% uplift.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: That matches the pricing sheet. Did you get approval for the extra 24 seats at the old discount?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Not yet, and this is the annoying part. To extend the agreement I have to update the seat count and dates in the CRM, then retype the same 110 seats, May 1 start, April 30 end, $64,900 total into the pricing sheet, then again into deal desk for approval, then again into the billing tool so they can preview the invoice, and then again into the proposal template. If legal tweaks anything, I have to walk it back through all five places. Last time this took me like two afternoons for one quote.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Ugh. For Hartley, deal desk should approve it if you attach the email from Dina confirming annual upfront. Keep the discount note simple, like renewal alignment.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, I have Dina’s email. She also asked for the PO number to show on page one, PO-44718, and their entity is Hartley Foods Services LLC, not the parent.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Good catch. Put the LLC on the order form and the parent only in the account notes. Anything else blocking signature?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Just the auto-renew language. They want 30 days’ notice instead of 60. Same thing we gave Northline last month, so I’m going to ask legal to approve that fallback.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Sounds fine. If you send me the draft before 3, I’ll sanity check the amounts and dates.
